issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'וּמְצֶאןָ מְנוּחָה אִשָּׁה בֵּית אִישָׁהּ' means 'and may you find rest, each of you in the house of her husband' — the subject is the women (Naomi's daughters-in-law) finding rest, not '得妻子' (obtain a wife). The Chinese rendering '各在丈夫的家中得妻子' incorrectly adds '得妻子' (obtain a wife), which is not in the Hebrew and changes the meaning: the Hebrew says the women will find rest in their husbands' houses, not that they will obtain wives. This is a substantive addition/mistranslation.
